Alchemize.note: obtain a random potion; utility, no deck job

Anointed.note: tutor: all Rare cards from draw pile into hand

BeaconOfHope.note: power (MP): allies get half your block gains

BeatDown.note: replays 3 attacks from discard; needs discard setup, empty turn 1

Bolas.note: 0-cost 3 dmg, returns to hand next turn

Calamity.note: power: each attack played adds random attack to hand

Catastrophe.note: plays 2 random cards from draw pile for free

Coordinate.note: MP: ally +5 temp Str this turn; amplifier, no direct dmg

DarkShackles.note: 0-cost enemy -9 Str this turn; damage prevention

Discovery.note: choose 1 of 3 random cards, free this turn

Entropy.note: power: transform 1 card in hand each turn; hand quality engine

EternalArmor.note: power: 9 Plating, block every turn end

Fisticuffs.note: 7 dmg, gain block equal to dmg dealt

GangUp.note: MP: 5 dmg +5 per ally hit on target this turn

GoldAxe.note: dmg = cards played this combat; grows over fight

HiddenGem.note: random card in draw pile gains Replay 2 for combat

Impatience.note: 0-cost draw 2 if no attacks in hand

Intercept.note: MP: 9 block + ally immune to attacks this turn

JackOfAllTrades.note: 0-cost add 1 random colorless card to hand

Jackpot.note: 25 dmg + add 3 random 0-cost cards to hand

Knockdown.note: MP: 10 dmg, target takes 2x from allies this turn

Mayhem.note: power: auto-play top card of draw pile each turn

Mimic.note: MP: gain block equal to ally's current block

MindBlast.note: innate, dmg = draw pile size; biggest on turn 1

Nostalgia.note: power: first attack/skill each turn goes to top of draw

Omnislice.note: 0-cost 8 dmg, then same dmg to all other enemies

Panache.note: power: every 5th card each turn deals 10 to all

PanicButton.note: 0-cost 30 block, no card block for 2 turns

PrepTime.note: power: 4 Vigor at start of each turn

Prolong.note: 0-cost carry current block into next turn

Purity.note: exhaust up to 3 cards from hand; deck thinning

Rend.note: 10 dmg +5 per debuff on target; 10 base for 1

Restlessness.note: retain; if only card in hand: draw 2, +2 energy

RollingBoulder.note: power: 5 dmg to all each turn, +5 per turn

SecretTechnique.note: 0-cost tutor a Skill from draw pile

SecretWeapon.note: 0-cost tutor an Attack from draw pile

SeekerStrike.note: 9 dmg + pick 1 of 3 random draw pile cards

Shockwave.note: 3 Weak + 3 Vuln to all enemies; weakens all

Splash.note: choose 1 of 3 other-class attacks, free this turn

Stratagem.note: power: on shuffle, tutor 1 card from draw pile

TagTeam.note: MP: 11 dmg, next ally attack on target plays twice

TheBall.note: MP: 10 dmg, +10 each play, passes to ally deck

TheBomb.note: 40 dmg to all after 3 turns; delayed, not frontloaded/scaling

TheGambit.note: 0-cost 50 block; die if hit unblocked this combat

ThinkingAhead.note: 0-cost draw 2, put 1 from hand on top of draw pile

ThrummingHatchet.note: 11 dmg, returns to hand next turn

Volley.note: X cost: 10 dmg x X to random enemies; spread unreliable
